## Decisions
- Removed ShippedBar from What Now — bare numbers with no context
- Menu bar deprecated — npx-first model
- `extras` catch-all on PortfolioAnalysis — unknown AI fields render as "More from AI"
- Single git log call for daily commits instead of 365 individual calls
- Charts side-by-side (grid layout) not stacked full-width
- Focus Goals removed from What Now — redundant with AI+GitHub
- "Since Last Visit" removed from What Now and Analytics — low value
- Treemap uses squarified algorithm in pure SVG (no D3 dependency)
- Lifecycle timeline uses activity windows (week/month/quarter) rather than daily data
- GitHub signals shows current-state only (no historical trending — we don't store time-series)
